name: 66604 · Topeka, KS
findings: ZIP 66604 (Topeka) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66604 (Topeka) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66604 (Topeka) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
